segments.name: Microscopy equipment
segments.description: Sells and develops microscopy equipment and related software for customers in Singapore, the Philippines and Indonesia.
segments.evidence: PTPL has been carrying on business since February 22, 2017 and is engaged in the sale and development of microscopy equipment and its related software.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay contractual service fees, with revenue recognized over time or upon completion and customer acceptance of services.
revenueModel.evidence: The amount of revenue recognized is based on the transaction price, which generally comprises the contractual service fee.

changes.text: In 2024, PTPL became the Company's indirect wholly-owned subsidiary through a share swap as part of an internal reorganization.
changes.evidence: On November 29, 2024, the Company proceeded with an internal reorganization whereby PTPL became our indirect wholly-owned subsidiary through a share swap.
